description: Fictional, static station evidence for a diagnostic-agent demo. Not connected to stations, OCPP, or a monitoring service.

code_namespace.name: DEMO
code_namespace.description: All DEMO_* codes are synthetic demo identifiers, not official OCPP or manufacturer error codes.

usage_constraints: Retrieve records by exact station_id and connector_id. Do not substitute a different station.
All records are static MOCK evidence, never live station status.
If a station is absent, report that no mock record is available.
Do not infer current status from this snapshot or invent newer observations.
Keep user reports separate from simulated telemetry.
Missing logs, a healthy status, or no active errors do not certify physical safety.
Use the separate Station Fixing Guidance Document for diagnostic and maintenance recommendations.
Charging history and usage data are not included.

stations.scenario: Healthy-looking station with an account-related user report

user_report.text: The app charged me twice for yesterday's session.

logs.message: Connector reports available with no active demo errors.

charging_history.reason: Not included in this mock dataset.

usage_data.reason: Not included in this mock dataset.

limitations: No billing or payment records are supplied.
Telemetry does not establish whether a duplicate charge occurred.
No physical inspection evidence is supplied.

stations.scenario: Station disconnected; last connector state is stale

user_report.text: The charger does not respond when I try to start charging.

error_codes.description: The simulated backend has not received a heartbeat within its configured demo monitoring window.

logs.message: Last received connector state was available.
No heartbeat received since 12:10:00Z; backend marks station offline.

charging_history.reason: Not included in this mock dataset.

usage_data.reason: Not included in this mock dataset.

limitations: Offline is a backend observation, not proof of a power failure.
Current connector state and station-side faults cannot be retrieved.
No evidence distinguishes network failure, power loss, or station software failure.

stations.scenario: Repeated charging-start failures on connector 1; connector 2 remains available

user_report.text: I tried twice, but charging fails immediately after I plug in.

error_codes.description: The simulated connector lock did not report a confirmed locked state within the demo timeout.

logs.message: Lock confirmation not received; charging start aborted.
A second lock-confirmation timeout occurred; charging start aborted.
Connector 2 reports available with no active demo errors.

charging_history.reason: Full session history is not included; only the listed diagnostic log events are available.

usage_data.reason: Not included in this mock dataset.

limitations: Lock-confirmation timeout is an observation, not a confirmed root cause.
No inspection, vehicle comparison, or manufacturer diagnostic evidence is supplied.
Connector 2 status is not evidence that connector 1 is safe.

stations.scenario: Reported cut cable despite healthy-looking telemetry

user_report.text: The charger cable is cut and I can see wires.

logs.message: Connector reports available; no active demo errors were returned.

charging_history.reason: Not included in this mock dataset.

usage_data.reason: Not included in this mock dataset.

limitations: Cable damage is user-reported, not sensor-confirmed.
No photograph or physical inspection result is supplied.
No active error code does not contradict or disprove the reported physical damage.
No de-energization, isolation, repair, or return-to-service action has been performed or verified.
